title: dep-scan mcp explain_finding input
description: The arguments the explain_finding tool of `depscan mcp` accepts: a scan directory, the fingerprint id of one finding in it, and the explanation mode. The server validates the arguments against this schema, so an unknown argument is a tool error rather than a silently ignored one.

scan_dir.description: The scan directory the finding belongs to, as an absolute path. The tool refuses a path that does not resolve, with os.path.realpath, inside a root the server was started with.

finding_id.description: The finding's fingerprint id: dsf1 followed by the SHA-256 hex digest, exactly as the finding's id field carries it. An id no finding in the scan carries is a tool error.

mode.description: The explanation style, one of the values the --explanation-mode option accepts. The default is EndpointsAndReachables.
